name: Sign-off
description: One line such as “Thank you for watching” between two hearts that follow its width; fades in, hearts pop.

controls.name: Position
controls.description: Centre of the row, in frame pixels (9x16: [540, 1160]); below the Credits block by default.

controls.name: Max Width
controls.description: Widest the row (hearts included) may be, in % of the frame width; a longer one shrinks to fit.

controls.name: Heart Size
controls.description: Width of each heart, in % of the font size.

controls.name: Shadow
controls.description: Strength of the soft shadow, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Blink
controls.description: The hearts beat: once popped in, fully on and off together, on for 60 % of each beat.

controls.name: Beats per Minute
controls.description: How fast the hearts beat with Blink on.

controls.name: Start
controls.description: When the text starts to fade and rise in, in seconds; the hearts pop in 0.25 s later.

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds; it fades out over its last 0.5 s.
